title: A/P Summary: a link naming several locations or every location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the organization has open A/P documents at three locations, location A, location B and location C.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick location C.
  2. In the address bar, replace the two "locationIds=" entries with one: "locationIds=" followed by the two codes separated by a comma.
  3. Press Enter.
  4. In the Location menu, click "Select all".
  5. Untick location A.
  6. Untick location B.
  7. In the address bar, replace location C's code with the three codes separated by commas: location A's and location B's (noted in step 1), then location C's.
  8. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report narrows to location A and location B.
  • The page address carries the two ticked locations as two "locationIds=" entries, each followed by a long code (the location's code, not its name).
  • Note the two codes.

Step 2:

  • The address bar shows one "locationIds=" entry with the two codes separated by a comma.

Step 3:

  • The link listing locations separated by commas opens the report with those two ticked ("Location: 2 locations").

Step 4:

  • Every location is ticked and the address no longer lists locations.

Step 5:

  • Location A is unticked.

Step 6:

  • Only location C is ticked.
  • The address holds one "locationIds=" entry: location C's code.

Step 7:

  • The address bar shows the three codes separated by commas.

Step 8:

  • A link naming every location opens as "Location: All locations".

The tester edits only the location part of the page address, in the same tab; pressing Enter opens the edited address as a link.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10: “The ticked locations are kept in the page address while fewer than all are ticked, so browser Back, a reload and a shared link restore them; a link listing several locations separated by commas is read as those locations. "No locations" is not kept in the address: a reload or shared link opens on All locations, as on Sales By Customer. A link naming every location reads as All locations.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D30: “URL keys asOfDate, customerIds / vendorIds, pastDue, locationIds (repeated keys written, comma lists also read); legacy customerId / vendorId read once as aliases.”
